sources.description: The Miami Hurricanes aren’t short on NFL talent entering the upcoming season. In fact, after sending nine players to the NFL in the 2026 NFL Draft, Miami has another talented group preparing to make its case to scouts. Some Hurricanes already have plenty of attention from NFL evaluators. Ahmad Moten, Cooper Barkate and Damon Wilson […]
